simple.meaning: Beth-Choron , the name of two adjoining places in Palestine
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to בֵּית חוֹרוֹן (H1032) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-loc.

simple.summary: בֵּית חוֹרוֹן (Bêyth Chôwrôwn) means Beth-Choron , the name of two adjoining places in Palestine First listed occurrence: 1Chr 6 53.
